About the role
Location: Remote (±3 timezones from PST)
About Bluelight
Bluelight is building software tools to help home service contractors build successful businesses.
We are relentlessly pursuing a world where analytics and AI products deliver actual real-world value, not just hype.
The Job at a Glance
Product engineers at Bluelight are truly full stack. You’ll design and ship the front end in React/Next.js, write Postgres and/or Clickhouse queries, and, depending on the team, develop and fine-tune machine learning models in Python.
* Work remotely with flexible hours.
* Engage with a team that’s driven by innovation and committed to operational excellence.
* Play a key role in a startup environment where your contributions have visible impacts.
* Enjoy the potential for contract extension and further professional growth within our company.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why you are a good fit for this role and Bluelight. Include examples of past projects related to user experience improvements or startup environments.
